transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we finalize the duty roster for the three uncovered exercise shifts — Tuesday 0600-1400, Wednesday 1400-2200, and Thursday 2200-0600 — I need to confirm a couple of things. Per the standing Monday personnel-sync routine, I need each company commander and the S-1 officer to report any roster changes before I publish the schedule. Alpha, Bravo, and the battalion support staff will each provide one team, and no team covers more than one shift. Once I have your updates, I'll assign the shifts and sign the roster with named shift handoffs for every assignment. What changes, if any, should I be aware of?

transcript.text: Maj. Alvarez, I need to report a roster change for Alpha Company. Our only currently qualified exercise-cell supervisor is Sgt. Ellis, and he is available only for the Tuesday 0600-1400 shift. He begins an instructor course Tuesday afternoon, so he cannot cover the Wednesday or Thursday shifts. I confirmed the course enrollment this morning, but the updated availability is not yet on the battalion roster.

I received the appointment confirmation yesterday, but it has not been added to the exercise staffing worksheet.
